snippet.title: HOMESICKNESS — Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
HOMESICKNESS is a point-&-click psychological horror indie game exploring the nuances of nostalgia. Play as Theo, trapped in CHILDREEF’s daycare, descending floor by floor; surviving the remnants of time. Use the Kids' multi-tool, listen to obscure tapes, and make your way to the lot. She's waiting.

Check out HOMESICKNESS on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597480/HOMESICKNESS/

Cut by @jnity, @celesware and @thatguyzanyt
